policy: This report is not an acceptance, source registration, ownership assignment, or geometry instruction. Count agreement is insufficient for acceptance.

findings: The broad gable sequence and ground commercial rhythm are legible, but the result remains a flat illustrated block rather than source-faithful component reconstruction.

Dark old balcony side-rail/return strokes remain visible after the cleanup rectangles. They read as tall repeated vertical side frames instead of the source's shallow, discrete rail-and-slab assemblies.
The repeated window/rail treatment is more uniform than the source. It should not be accepted because the visible balcony count happens to agree.
frontPreview.action: Remove or replace the residual painted rail returns before judging any raised balcony geometry; then compare each retained rail/slab against source-visible support.

findings: The overlay has 8 entrance candidates versus the review-only source inventory's 7 doorway-like apertures, while its 10 shopfront candidates fragment approximately 4 visible shopfront groups into individual bays.

ground-004, ground-005, ground-006 and ground-009 are entrance proposals made by symmetric-arch or filled-colour fallback with no fitted edge; they require classifier abstention or a grouped outcome, not automatic doorway promotion.
ground-007 is already uncertain and overlaps the same local generated-ground logic as neighbouring entrances; it must not reach assembly geometry.
ground-010/011 and ground-015 through ground-018 are individual glazing-bay candidates. Treating them as separate shopfronts would overstate shop count; group-level classification is needed.
entranceOverlay.action: Use an ID-only grouping/classifier pass with explicit unknown output. Retain candidate provenance, but render neither fallback entrances nor per-bay shopfronts until grouped and independently checked against the original.

findings: It removes the source-visible balcony rail/slab assemblies entirely, so it cannot be used as a balcony mask, opening mask, or evidence of flat wall surface at those positions.
It simplifies upper facade and eave detail and retains illustrated opening and signage treatment; these changes are drift, not measured correction.
The broad facade segmentation and major gable sequence remain useful as an explicitly inferred whole-block texture/region hypothesis.
bananaClean.allowedUse: Opt-in generated-image ablation for broad inferred wall/roof region appearance only, with source and generated layers visibly separable.
bananaClean.disallowedUse: Albedo claim, component coordinates, door/balcony masks, registration fitting, owner assignment, or release texture.

nextGate: Re-render after residual rail removal and candidate grouping. Judge source-supported rail extent, entrance role and shopfront grouping separately; do not accept a pass from matching totals.
